node.statement: Raw input estimates and domain typing: with the constants and rho of 1.1, every U,V in calU satisfy ||(U bold-dot V)^dagger bold-dot (U bold-dot V)-J||<=3*epsilon_r and U bold-dot V has a right inverse, while ||(U^dagger)^dagger bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=2*epsilon_r and U^dagger has the right inverse U. Consequently U bold-dot V and U^dagger both belong to calU_rho and hence to S_delta.
